exceptions.reason: The Expo SDK 54 toolchain locks @expo/cli 54.0.28 to glob ^13.0.0. The first patched glob release is 14.0.2, outside that declared major range. npm audit proposes an Expo SDK 58.1.0 major migration; forcing glob 14 into SDK 54 would bypass Expo's compatibility contract.
exceptions.mitigation: The affected glob copy is in the Expo CLI/build toolchain; the mobile application source does not import glob or expose glob patterns to learners. This remains a build-environment risk, not a zero-risk finding. Keep the exact lockfile, avoid processing untrusted project configuration, and remove this exception only after a tested Expo SDK migration or an in-range upstream patch.

exceptions.reason: Expo SDK 54's @expo/cli declares minimatch ^9.0.0 and glob 13.0.6 declares minimatch ^10.2.2. The first patched release is 11.0.1, outside both declared major ranges. npm audit proposes an Expo SDK 58.1.0 major migration; forcing minimatch 11 into SDK 54 would bypass upstream compatibility constraints.
exceptions.mitigation: The affected copies are transitive Expo CLI/build-tool dependencies; the mobile application source does not import minimatch or accept learner-controlled glob patterns. This remains a build-environment risk, not a zero-risk finding. Keep the exact lockfile, avoid processing untrusted project configuration, and remove this exception only after a tested Expo SDK migration or an in-range upstream patch.
